summary: DeepFilterNet2 keeps the voice of a video and takes out background noise as the background, offline, on the CPU, in about a tenth of the time the video plays; cleaner than RNNoise. Small: the 9 MB model is in the add-on. Made for noise, not music: for a voice over music, use HTDemucs.
author: Subtitld

fields.label: CPU threads
fields.help: 0 picks the performance cores on a CPU that also has efficiency cores, else one thread per core. Fewer leaves the computer more responsive while it separates.
